automatic_selection_policy: auto chooses the first GPU visible to the current PyTorch CUDA-compatible runtime (CUDA or ROCm); if no usable GPU is visible, it chooses CPU. The selected device and backend are recorded in the run.

execution_limits.custom_batch_objects: User-defined objects are passed through unchanged; use external-loop context.to_device(batch) or move their tensors in user code.

coverage: auto falls back to CPU when no GPU is visible and records the selected device

atomic checkpoint save and resume on the same selected device
manual-step optimizer update on one GPU
injected GPU out-of-memory error reports phase and measured resources
